# Tallow Labs price book and standalone sales data (2025-07 to 2026-06)

Prepared by RevOps from the billing system. "Standalone" means sold to a customer without
any other Tallow product on the same order.

## Subscription (Analytics Platform)
- List price: $120 per seat per year. Minimum 25 seats.
- New-logo annual deals, 142 orders: median $114 per seat per year, 80% of orders between
  $104 and $120.
- Add-on seats bought mid-term by existing customers, 61 orders: median $118, 80% between
  $112 and $120. RevOps notes add-on discounting is rare because procurement is already done.
- Renewals, 97 orders: median $117.

## Implementation (standard onboarding)
- Price book: $6,000 flat, charged on the first order only. Not sold standalone. Consists
  of tenant provisioning, SSO configuration, and loading the customer's historical data
  into Tallow's schema. Only Tallow staff can perform it (proprietary loaders). Customers
  cannot use the platform before it is done.

## Training
- $2,500 per half-day session, remote. 38 standalone sessions sold to existing customers,
  all at $2,500.

## Consulting and data migration
- Rate card $175 per hour. Also sold by three certified partners at $160 to $190 per hour.
- 2025 standalone engagements: 22, effective rate $168 per hour.

## Customer relationship data
- Average customer life, all new-logo customers: 3 years (2021 to 2025 cohorts, stable).
  Customers who paid the implementation fee show the same 3 years.
